## Hundreds of ready-to-send pieces, written for your industry.

Check-ins, holiday wishes, birthday notes, and the updates your clients actually care about. The library covers email, newsletters, blogs, social posts with images included, and handwritten cards. It's organized so you can find the right piece in seconds and send it in a click. New content arrives all year, so there's always something current.

## Know what to send before you need to.

Your content calendar shows everything scheduled across email, social, and blogs in one view. Turn on suggestions and Levitate recommends what to send based on the time of year and your industry. When our Content Team drafts something for you, it shows up right on the calendar, waiting for your approval.

## Every piece sounds like it was written just for them.

Merge fields fill in the details that make a message personal: a first name, a birthday, anything you've saved about the client. Want to add a line to just one email in a batch? You can. Some templates are built to be personalized, and those won't send until you've filled in the parts that need you.

## When you want something new, Lev writes it in your voice.

Describe what you want in plain language and Lev drafts it, whether that's an email, a social post, or a card. He'll also rewrite, shorten, warm up, or translate anything you already have. Point him at your website once and everything he creates picks up your colors, fonts, and style, so it looks like it came from you and not from a template.

Questions to ask before you hire a local pro

Hiring someone local should feel easy. A few good questions up front can save you time, money and a lot of second-guessing.

Start with experience. Ask how long they've been doing this work, and whether they've helped someone in a situation like yours.

**Frequently asked questions**

How many quotes should I get?

Two or three is plenty. More than that and the details start to blur.

Should I ask for references?

Yes. A good pro is happy to connect you with people they've helped.

## Content FAQs

Who writes Levitate's content?

Our in-house content team, with writers who specialize in the industries we serve. Every piece is reviewed and updated regularly.

Won't my clients get the same email as everyone else's clients?

Your clients see a message from you, sent from your own inbox, filled in with details about them. You can personalize any piece by hand or have Lev rewrite it in your own style.

Can I use my own content?

Absolutely. Write from scratch, save your own templates, or ask Lev to help you draft.

Does content cost extra?

No. The library, the calendar, your Success Specialist, and Lev are all included with Levitate.
